title: Odd-wise frequency family size
statement:
Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $k$ be odd. There is a family $\\mathcal F$ of subsets of $[n]$ such that $|S\\cup T|\\le k$ for every $S,T\\in\\mathcal F$, and
\[|\\mathcal F|=\\sum_{j=0}^{(k-1)/2}\\binom{n}{j}+\\binom{n-1}{(k-1)/2}.\]
